consequences: Pinned LinkML 1.11.1 supplies selected standard-field meaning while adapters remain replaceable behind one neutral output contract.
Every adapter passes generic neutral-result conformance; each source language owns a named and versioned source profile and corpus, and only a LinkML compatibility claim requires the LinkML corpus.
Applied defaults become explicit values with provenance and the runtime never infers frontend defaults.
constraints: Classify simple parity and explicit false as EQUAL; parent/mixin precedence, numeric bounds, default range, and attribute slot usage as LINKML; and repeated plus both conflicting mixin orders as REFUSE.
V0 provides no legacy OntologyRegistry emulation; public adapter docstrings must surface through Sphinx.
data.selected_option: Pinned LinkML 1.11.1 replaceable default frontend adapter

summary: Accept pinned LinkML as the replaceable default frontend adapter.
why: CC-X01 supplies nine immutable two-engine observations. Exact classification delegates supported LinkML meaning without preserving a second legacy interpretation layer or allowing ambiguous mixin order to decide semantics.
